title: Yackandandah North, VIC - Infrastructure Restoration

cause.high_level: Planned works by an upstream provider

current_summary: An upstream provider experienced an unplanned access network outage affecting some services in Yackandandah North, VIC. The interruption began at 7:44 AM and services were restored by 10:14 AM AEST on 3 July 2026. The outage was linked to planned works by an upstream provider. Services are stable and we are monitoring.

updates.content: Resolved: Some customers in Yackandandah North, VIC were affected by an upstream access network issue. Services were restored at 10:14 AM AEST on 3 July 2026. If you’re still offline, please restart your modem/router and contact us if the issue continues. We’re monitoring and appreciate your patience.
